t: Distilling the "Doozy": Achieving Mechanical Advantage in Code Refactoring with AI
s: This article details refactoring a complex Jupyter Notebook 'doozy' into modular Python functions through human-AI collaboration. It emphasizes transforming 'hoarded domain expertise' into reusable components for automated data processing and Excel formatting, leveraging libraries like openpyxl.
sub: Refactoring monolithic Jupyter Notebook cells into modular Python functions
Automated data processing and Excel formatting with openpyxl
Extracting and organizing 'hoarded domain expertise' into discrete components
Applying specific formatting rules (widths, colors, fonts, conditional formatting) to Excel sheets using openpyxl
